seattle.rule: There is no garbage, recycling, or food and yard waste collection on Thanksgiving Day, Christmas Day, or New Year's Day. If your regular collection day falls on or after one of these holidays, your service will be delayed by one day for the remainder of the week.

oklahoma-city.rule: City-observed holidays affect trash and recycling only on the holiday itself: the City schedules a make-up day (Wednesday for Monday holidays, Saturday for Thursday/Friday holidays; e.g. Labor Day Sept 7, 2026 → Wednesday Sept 9). Other days that week are collected as usual. Bulky waste pickup is not affected.

miami-dade.rule: Waste is collected on all holidays (as observed by Miami-Dade County) except Martin Luther King, Jr. Day, Independence Day and Christmas Day. Service after one of these holidays will be provided on your next regularly scheduled collection day.

orlando.rule: The Solid Waste Division observes Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day as the only holidays where residential garbage, recycling, and yard waste collection services are not provided. When these holidays fall on a regularly scheduled collection day, service for the remainder of the week is delayed by one day.

richmond.rule: There’s no pickup on City holidays. Collection resumes the day after the holiday and continues through Friday.

irving.rule: If a residential collection day (trash, recycling, or brush/bulky items) falls on a city holiday, collection typically shifts to the next day for each service day within that holiday week (e.g., Monday moves to Tuesday, Tuesday to Wednesday, etc.).

honolulu.rule: Christmas Day and New Year’s Day are the only holidays when refuse, recycling, green waste, and bulky items are not collected. If your scheduled gray cart collection day falls on one of these holidays, please leave your cart at the curb; it will be serviced within the following days. Recycling (blue cart) and green waste (green cart) will not be made up; hold items until the next regularly scheduled pickup date.

madison.rule: The City of Madison Streets Division does not perform trash, recycling, brush, or large item collections on City-observed holidays. When a holiday falls on a weekday, collection services are typically delayed (for example, Monday collections moved to Tuesday). Drop-off sites and Streets Division offices are also closed.

huntsville.rule: On observed holidays, residential garbage, recycling, and yard waste collection is generally delayed by one day for the remainder of the week (e.g., regular Monday pickup would occur on Tuesday). If your collection date falls on a holiday, place your cans at the curb the evening before the next business day.

long-beach.rule: Collection services are interrupted only on Christmas Day (December 25) and New Year's Day (January 1). For all other holidays, refuse, recycling, and organics are collected on your regular schedule. When Christmas Day and New Year’s Day fall on a weekday, collection for the holiday and the remainder of that week will be delayed by one day, with the final collection occurring on Saturday. If the holiday falls on a Saturday, collection will occur on the Friday before the holiday.

irvine.rule: If your regular service day falls on or follows one of the observed holidays during the week (Monday–Friday), your pickup will be delayed by one day for that week only. If an observed holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday, there is no delay to your service.

toledo.rule: Trash collection is delayed by one day for the following holidays: New Year's Day, Memorial Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving, Christmas.

fort-wayne.rule: The City of Fort Wayne observes federal holidays annually that affect solid waste and recycling collection. During these holiday weeks, collection services run one day behind for the remainder of the week. If a holiday falls on a weekday, collections for that day and all subsequent days that week are delayed by one day.

cambridge.rule: Weekly Collections (Note: One day behind schedule following a holiday.)

los-angeles.rule: Most holidays do not change your collection day. For most of the year, you should put your bins out on your normal day. However, for four major holidays in 2026, our Los Angeles Sanitation and Environment (LASAN) crews take a break, which means your pickup will be pushed back by one day. When a major holiday falls on a weekday, everyone’s service is "bumped" one day later for the rest of that week.

baton-rouge.rule: Solid waste collection will not occur on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, or Christmas Day. If the holiday occurs on a collection day, services will be provided on the next scheduled collection day unless notified otherwise.

cedar-rapids.rule: When holidays fall during the week, it may postpone your collection. View our calendar and see if an upcoming holiday will change your collection.

denver.rule: When service falls on or after an observed holiday, your collection will be delayed one day for the rest of that week only (for example, for a Monday holiday, collections will be on Tuesday, Tuesday's collection on Wednesday, etc., with Thursday's collections on Friday for that week only). There will be no delayed scheduled for working holidays.

rancho-cucamonga.rule: When the holiday falls on a weekday, collections for the remainder of the week will be delayed by one day. There is no service interruption or delay when the holiday falls on a Saturday or Sunday.

corpus-christi.rule: There will be no collection on the following holidays. Please note alternate collection dates. Solid Waste Services will continue as scheduled for all other federal holidays.

tucson.rule: The only dates in 2026 that will have delayed service are New Year's Day, Thanksgiving and Christmas.

philadelphia.rule: Trash and recyclables are not collected on City holidays. Trash and recycling collection will be one day behind schedule for the rest of the week after a holiday.

roseville.rule: Garbage and green waste pick up still occurs on holidays.

charlotte.rule: Starting in January 2026, Martin Luther King Jr. Day, Memorial Day and Labor Day will follow an updated collection pattern. There will be no collection on the holiday (Monday). Crews will begin service on Tuesday and work through Friday to complete all routes. No Saturday collection will occur during these holiday weeks. No yard waste will be collected during these weeks so crews can focus on completing garbage and recycling routes. Residents should set their carts out on their normal collection day and leave them at the curb until they are collected. Pickup may occur later in the week than usual. What’s Staying the Same Thanksgiving and Christmas will continue to operate on a one-day delay, consistent with previous years: During Thanksgiving week, Thursday collection will be serviced Friday and Friday collection will be serviced Saturday. During Christmas week, Friday collection will be serviced Saturday.

fresno.rule: The Residential Collection Schedule DOES NOT change for the following holidays: Martin Luther King Jr. Day President’s Day Memorial Day Independence Day Labor Day Veterans Day The Residential Collection Schedule DOES change for the following holidays, as outlined below: Thanksgiving Day Day after Thanksgiving Christmas Day New Year’s Day Pickup schedules for these holidays vary depending upon which day of the week the holiday falls.

waco.rule: PICKUPS SCHEDULED ON OR AFTER HOLIDAYS WILL SLIDE ONE DAY FORWARD

detroit.rule: Collection will be pushed back one day following a holiday. For example, if a holiday is on Tuesday and your normal collection day is Wednesday, you will be serviced on Thursday. Customers who are normally serviced on Friday will be serviced on Saturday.
